_meta.notes: A 2013 year-end filed on a stale form whose printed interim dates all read 2012; the Year-End box is checked and neither amendment box is. Signature date '1-31-14'; clerk RECEIVED stamp JAN 31 2014. Column B is headed 'Year to Date'. Arithmetic on the face is internally consistent (141.00 + 234.06 = 375.06; 375.06 - 123.00 = 252.06).

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: This filing uses the TYPED variant of the form, which prints only a TOTAL line per schedule (no per-page SUBTOTAL row). p3 rows 234.06 = printed TOTAL 234.06 - GATE PASSES. p4 rows 123.00 = printed TOTAL 123.00 - GATE PASSES (23 rows).
itemized.notes: BORN-DIGITAL TYPED filing (not handwritten) - the only one of its kind in this chunk, so every value is crisp. The contributor MAILING ADDRESS block is covered by a solid BLACK REDACTION BOX applied before scanning: county-redacted, not a filer omission. Both contributions are the candidate's own money. Every expenditure is a Key Bank account fee. Page layout is unusual: p4 carries the expenditures table and then the heading 'ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED' at the foot with nothing under it, while the contributions rows sit on p3 - a document-assembly artifact, noted, nothing inferred from it. Clerk RECEIVED stamp JAN 31 2014.
